capabilities: reload enabled plugins from a searchable picker
reload the last plugin with one command
generate dedicated reload commands for chosen plugins
disambiguation: Not an automatic hot-reload tool; it never watches files or rebuilds code, it only speeds up the manual reload step.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.8.7+); no network requests or telemetry; the plugin hides itself from its own reload list by default; only lists currently enabled plugins.
intentEvidence: If you prefer automatic file watching and broader developer utilities, a larger toolbox plugin may suit you better.
motivation: The author wanted a dedicated, manual, low-friction reloader for keyboard-driven plugin development, without automatic file watching or bundled developer tools.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly reload a single plugin during development, forcing developers to restart or navigate settings repeatedly.
summary: Developer utility that reloads enabled Obsidian plugins on demand from a searchable command-palette picker.
